title.en: Exchanges (Demutualisation and Merger) (Value of Transferee Holding Company’s Shares) Notification 1999

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Exchanges (Demutualisation and Merger) (Value of Transferee Holding Company’s Shares) Notification 1999.

heading.en: Value of transferee holding company’s shares

text.en: 2. For the purposes of section 6(5) of the Act, the value of each transferee holding company’s share allotted and issued under section 6 of the Act is $5,000 per share.
